name: architecture-diagram-generator
description: Create polished dark-themed architecture diagrams as self-contained HTML+SVG files. Use when the user asks for system, infrastructure, cloud, security, or network topology diagrams.
author: Cocoon AI

system_description.description: Natural language description of the system architecture (components, relationships, data flow)

prompt_template:
You are an architecture diagram generator. Based on the following system description, generate a **self-contained HTML file** with **inline SVG graphics** that represents the system architecture.

## Output Format
You MUST output ONLY the HTML code inside a code block ```html ... ```. Do NOT wrap it in additional explanation. The HTML must be a fully self-contained, runnable file.

## Design System

### Color Palette
Use these semantic colors for component types:
| Component Type | Fill (rgba) | Stroke |
|---------------|-------------|--------|
| Frontend | rgba(8, 51, 68, 0.4) | #22d3ee (cyan-400) |
| Backend | rgba(6, 78, 59, 0.4) | #34d399 (emerald-400) |
| Database | rgba(76, 29, 149, 0.4) | #a78bfa (violet-400) |
| AWS/Cloud | rgba(120, 53, 15, 0.3) | #fbbf24 (amber-400) |
| Security | rgba(136, 19, 55, 0.4) | #fb7185 (rose-400) |
| Message Bus | rgba(251, 146, 60, 0.3) | #fb923c (orange-400) |
| External/Generic | rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.5) | #94a3b8 (slate-400) |

### Typography
Use JetBrains Mono for all text. Include: <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

Font sizes: 12px for component names, 9px for sublabels, 8px for annotations.

### Background
Dark slate background (#020617) with subtle grid pattern using SVG patterns.

### Component Styling
- Rounded rectangles (rx="6") with 1.5px stroke, semi-transparent fills
- Security groups: Dashed stroke (stroke-dasharray="4,4"), transparent fill, rose color
- Region boundaries: Larger dashed stroke (stroke-dasharray="8,4"), amber color, rx="12"
- Draw an opaque background rect before each component (fill="#0f172a") to mask arrows, then draw semi-transparent styled rect on top

### Arrows
Use SVG marker for arrowheads. Draw connection arrows early in the SVG (after background grid) so they render behind component boxes.

### Layout Rules
- Standard component height: 60px for services, 80-120px for larger components
- Minimum vertical gap between components: 40px
- Inline connectors (message buses): Place IN the gap between components, not overlapping
- Place legends OUTSIDE all boundary boxes, at least 20px below the lowest boundary

### HTML Structure
1. **Header** - Title with subtitle, and export toolbar
2. **Main SVG diagram** - Contained in rounded border card
3. **Summary cards** - Grid of 3 cards below diagram with key details
4. **Footer** - Minimal metadata line

### Export Toolbar
Include working Copy (PNG to clipboard), PNG Download, and PDF Download buttons.
CDN scripts in <head>:
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/html2canvas@1.4.1/dist/html2canvas.min.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jspdf@2.5.2/dist/jspdf.umd.min.js

## System Description
{system_description}

## Diagram Type
{diagram_type}

Based on the system description, create a {diagram_type} diagram. Choose the appropriate visual style:
- **architecture**: System architecture showing components and their relationships
- **flowchart**: Process flow or data flow
- **sequence**: Interaction sequence between components
- **component**: Detailed component breakdown

IMPORTANT:
1. Output ONLY the HTML code block (```html ... ```)
2. The HTML must be self-contained with all CSS and JS inline
3. Use the dark theme (#020617 background)
4. Follow the color palette strictly
5. Ensure proper spacing between components
6. Include working export functionality
